text: A trolley is heading toward five people. Pull the lever and it switches to a track with one person.
Five people are tied to the track. The man who tied them there stands on the side track. Pull the lever and it hits him instead.
A trolley is heading toward two children. Pull the lever and it hits three adults instead.
Five people climbed onto the track for a selfie. A trolley is coming. Pull the lever and it hits one railway worker instead.
Pull the lever and the trolley goes onto a loop. One person on the loop stops it before it comes back around to the five.
A trolley is heading toward five strangers. Pull the lever and it hits your worst enemy instead.
Pull a lever to open a trapdoor. A man falls onto the track and stops the trolley before it hits five people.
A trolley is heading toward five strangers. Pull the lever and it hits your own child instead.
A trolley is heading toward a pregnant woman. Pull the lever and it hits two people instead.
You drive the trolley and the brakes fail. Pull the lever to steer onto a side track with one worker instead of five.
A trolley is heading toward the world's best surgeon. Pull the lever and it hits two strangers instead.
A trolley is heading toward five 90-year-olds. Pull the lever and it hits one 10-year-old instead.
A trolley is heading toward one innocent person. Pull the lever and it hits five convicted murderers instead.
A trolley is heading toward ten people. Pull the lever and it hits nine people instead.
A trolley is heading toward your best friend. Pull the lever and it hits five strangers instead.
A trolley is heading toward five people. Pull the lever and it hits one person. Nobody will ever know it was you.
Pull the lever to save five people and kill one. Afterwards, you go on trial for the death of the one.
A trolley is heading toward five convicted bank robbers. Pull the lever and it hits one doctor instead.
A trolley is heading toward five people. Pull the lever and it hits one scientist who is close to a cure for cancer.
A trolley is heading toward five people. Pull the lever and it hits one person who has only weeks to live.
A trolley is heading toward five people. The one person on the side track volunteered to take their place.
A trolley is heading toward five people. Pull the lever to switch it onto the track where you are tied.
You pulled the lever by mistake. The trolley now heads toward one person instead of five. Pull it again to switch it back.
A trolley is heading toward you. Pull the lever and it hits five strangers instead.
A trolley is heading toward 100 people. Pull the lever and it hits your mother instead.
